verdict.rationale: The client API lets users submit tasks with `create_task` and collect the results later. That makes long-running autonomous agent jobs run in the background, with Kosmos covering literature, code execution and hypotheses end-to-end. However, the evidence shows no native automation features: no scheduling, recurring runs, triggers or webhooks, so any orchestration has to be scripted by the user. Missing for 10: scheduled/recurring automations, event triggers or webhooks for completion, a first-party automation builder, and independent hands-on corroboration.
